answer: Liveness-bound personhood stops Sybil farming at the human: each agent must present a fresh liveness check tied to one real-world credential, so one person equals one agent and the delta between a real user and a bot farm is provable. An attacker cannot echo the same face across a ledge of fake accounts, because every copy fails the live challenge. A farm needs a new real person for every fake, turning free software copies into expensive recruitment.
